alex: deploybot just paused the release window for release-id=rls-2027-09-21. flagged mismatch between staging and prod for inference cache path + encryption flag. @maria can you take a look? :eyes:

deploybot: RELEASE HOLD: rls-2027-09-21. Reason: env-parity-check FAILED. diffs detected: `INFER_CACHE_PREFIX` (staging=`/cache/stg/models/v2/`, prod=`/cache/prod/models/v2`) and `KMS_ENCRYPTED=true` in staging vs `KMS_ENCRYPTED=false` in prod. See /release/rls-2027-09-21/preflight.log

maria: ack. weird — I thought the infra default sets KMS_ENCRYPTED on both. checking paramstore and helm values now.

sam: quick note: this release pins model to `redwood/model-v2.3.1` so cache prefix matters — pointing prod at the wrong prefix could cause cold-cache explosion and higher egress costs.

jen: also want to call out change window: we have a 30m deploy window left. if we need a hotpatch for prod values, might need to request out-of-band approval from ops.

maria: found the diff — staging Helm override has `inference.kvPrefix: /cache/stg/models/v2/` and `encryption.enabled: true` in values-staging.yaml. prod values file uses `inference.kvPrefix: /cache/prod/models/` (missing v2 suffix) and `encryption.enabled: false`. Looks like a manual edit slipped into prod config in june.

alex: thanks. options: (1) back out release, (2) patch prod to match staging (add v2 suffix + enable encryption), or (3) update release to point at prod prefix and disable encryption on canary only. preferences?

sam: option 3 risky — disabling encryption on canary would change runtime behavior and might violate audit for some customers. lean toward patching prod to match staging then promote.

jen: agreed. patch prod -> verify canary -> promote. but need to coordinate with security for KMS change. @ops-bot open ticket?

ops-bot: Ticket created: OPS-5921. Title: "Enable inference encryption + kvPrefix v2 on prod to restore env parity". SLA: standard change review required. Link: https://phabricator.internal/OPS-5921

maria: deploying a small change now to prod values (dry-run first). snippet: ```helm upgrade redwood-infer -f values.prod.yaml --set inference.kvPrefix=/cache/prod/models/v2/ --set encryption.enabled=true --dry-run```

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK: dry-run succeeded. however, backend reports missing KMS alias permission for service account `infra-inference-prod` when trying to enable encryption: `AccessDeniedException: kms:Encrypt`.

alex: ok blocked by permissions. @security-team we need a quick grant for `infra-inference-prod` to use kms alias `alias/rw-infer-prod` limited to `Encrypt,Decrypt` and logged. Can we get an emergency ACL?

sam: meanwhile, to keep the release timeline, we should consider reverting the staging override (i.e., change staging to match prod) if security can't approve in the window. revert would avoid changing prod permissions but would delay the new model pinning behavior. trade-offs: lower risk vs losing v2 cache benefits.

jen: decision: hold promotion for now. ops to expedite KMS ACL. if ACL not approved in 45m, revert staging override and reschedule the release for the next change window.

maria: noted. I'll slice the PR to either apply prod patch (pending ACL) or rollback staging override. PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/merge_requests/3214 — description lists both paths and includes a toggle `inference.kmsFallback=false` to toggle behavior quickly.

alex: thanks. I'll update release notes to capture this: "Promotion paused due to env parity (kvPrefix & encryption) mismatch; action: pending KMS ACL or staging rollback. Impact: temporary delay to model-v2.3.1 rollout; cost/latency unchanged if rollback chosen."

deploybot: RELEASE_STATUS: hold -> awaiting ops ticket OPS-5921 and merge request 3214 review.

sam: tl;dr: release paused, security ACL required to enable encryption in prod, fallback plan is to revert staging defaults if ACL not granted.

jen: adding slack reminder for 30m. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan or :warning: if you prefer immediate rollback.

alex: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:

jen: pinging security on call channel now. keeping this thread updated.
